rules: SINGLE and UNKNOWN records cannot carry pairing identity.
START/STOP pairing identity requires an explicit deterministic source token.
Pair validation never guesses or repairs missing, duplicate, or conflicting pair identity.
The contract carries no pitch, octave, onset, duration, voice, staff, tie, grace, chord membership, candidate, ranking, or solver fields.
